goldens.lesson: Simple fixed-denominator assignment plus reallocation can produce complete worker flow; preserve as a modern measurable control for pipeline changes.
goldens.caution: This proves the measured CATLAB flow, not the future 10x100x2 architecture.

goldens.lesson: The historical 100-task pool is the key simplicity benchmark: resident workers repeatedly finished work and immediately selected another task. Preserve its operational pattern even before exact historic receipts are recovered.
goldens.required_followup: Locate exact durable run/receipt before upgrading numeric observations to VERIFIED.
goldens.design_value: Even if numeric details are later corrected, its worker-loop pattern is a protected baseline candidate.

goldens.lesson: Modern lease/recovery/evaluation guarantees can live below a minimal worker path: direct BOOTSTRAP->WORK followed by repeated SUBMIT_AND_NEXT.
goldens.caution: Synthetic runtime proof only. Real fresh-chat and 20-worker E0 remain pending.

anti_goldens.observation: 20 tagged workers, 0 scored >=8/10, maximum tagged score 5.
anti_goldens.lesson: Do not promote a protocol from one impressive worker; reproduction matters.
If workers perform after reaching WORK but most fail before/around assignment, diagnose orchestration/admission before changing cognition or scaling.
anti_goldens.causal_note: Old grid admission selected the oldest ARMED/SEALED run. A SEALED run could remain first, preventing new workers from reaching later grids; admission was also not launch-batch scoped.

replacement_rule: A Golden may be superseded only by a newer independently reproduced baseline with equal-or-better preserved capabilities. Never delete lineage.
